exclusionPredicates.predicate: REJECT if the candidate causal graph becomes any definitelyClosed graph after deleting names, numeric constants, presentation text and carrier encoding.
REJECT if both producer and consumer are existing authored transitions and the only addition is a bit, mark, status, identity or ordering rule.
REJECT if novelty is only target relation, instance history, cross-turn hold, intent history, action scheduling or subeffect order.
REJECT if mediator or payoff is computed solely as threshold, excess, precision, overflow, residue, cap difference or scalar conversion of existing state.
REJECT if replacing the proposed carrier with status, flag, UID, CardInst, trace, questScratch or save storage leaves producer, consumer, payoff and expiry unchanged.
REJECT if novelty depends on acquisition, ownership, offer/reward route, package assignment, selector, priority, optimiser or policy retuning rather than a new semantic transition.

REJECT AS NEW if producer is positive terminal Ember after canonical victory consumers, mediator is one durable carry, consumer is the next-combat post-start-relic boundary, payoff is one capped Ember and expiry is next start or run end.
REJECT if the work repairs, reruns, substitutes, extrapolates from or promotes emberglass-memory-one-carry after its zero-execution identity inconclusive.
REJECT any Ward-spend threshold, policy, method, representation or rescue variant.

Classify a slot as genuinely unoccupied only if accepted evidence supplies a complete materially new producer, mediator, consumer, payoff and lifecycle; current source supplies the required deterministic seams; and X1-X9 are all false. A storage or routing seam alone fails this predicate.
